stance_rationale: The revised package is more honest than Round 1, but the selected C2 still fails the explicit monotonicity hard gate at 0.50 < 0.70 and remains NON_GRADUATING. critical_concerns.description: Selected C2 still fails the hard monotonicity mandate: 0.50 vs required 0.70, with Q2 as the max-return quintile. NON_GRADUATING is honest, but any optimizer admission path remains unsupported.
RF-A6 remains active because the mandated CAPM/FF3/Carhart4/FF5/FF6 model panel was not computed; base/trim/subperiod stress tests are not the same econometric verification.
C13 is still unresolved: explicit low-vol sign inversion is economically plausible, but the strict rule requires Z_Score_Aligned and bans manual sign flips.

C15 compliance is not proven under the role prompt's strict wording because factor construction directly reads raw parquet and bypasses load_month_factors(); the RAWDATA exemption needs explicit governance approval.

AX-005/AX-007 exception proof is deferred to future multi-sleeve optimization, but weights.csv, covariance.parquet, risk_package, and optimization_package are absent, so non-degenerate sleeve mix, turnover, cost, PSD, and condition-number claims cannot be verified.
AX-001 conditional defense evidence is not present: no crisis_alpha, Core-relative MDD mitigation, bad/normal IC ratio, ES/CVaR/CDaR, or Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined split is provided.

Artifact lineage is split: the primary qepm stage path requested by the user is absent, the run log records C5 selection, while final package/alpha_scores are C2 after overwrite; this weakens reproducibility auditability.

supporting_arguments: Selected C2 passes nominal IC gates: rank_IC=0.0491, ICIR=0.4277, t_NW=7.002, DSR=14.348, subperiod_stability=1.0.
RF-A7 single-snapshot risk is low: 268 monthly sig_dates from 2004-01-30 to 2026-04-30 with variable ticker counts.
PIT-C2 and PIT-C10 are materially improved versus the parent: forward returns use sig_date+1 close and liquidity uses ADV_20d_lag1.
Top-decile liquidity is verified above the 2e8 KRW hard floor in the fallback alpha_scores artifact.
Orthogonality versus STR_1715 is strong by reported post-fix correlations: Pearson=0.0038 and Spearman=-0.0605.

Whether literal CAPM/FF3/Carhart4/FF5/FF6 t_NW remains >2.95 once KR factors are built.
Whether C13/C15 RAWDATA and explicit-sign exemptions are allowed by governance rather than merely asserted in the package.
Whether AX-005/AX-007 multi-sleeve exception will survive real weights, covariance, turnover, cost, and capacity checks.
Whether final artifacts should be regenerated into the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts path with lineage for alpha_scores, not only alpha_package.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that C2's 4-of-5 statistical passes plus orthogonality are enough to keep a KR low-vol sleeve admission path open despite a monotonicity hard-gate failure and unproven AX-005/AX-007 multi-sleeve exception.
rebuttal_required: Either produce monotonicity >=0.70 or formally mark this alpha as research-only with no optimizer/PG2 admission path.
Provide the literal CAPM/FF3/Carhart4/FF5/FF6 t_NW lag6 panel and recalculate DSR using the true specification count.

Provide weights.csv and covariance.parquet before invoking AX-005/AX-007 multi-sleeve sufficiency.
Provide AX-001 crisis_alpha, Core-relative MDD mitigation, bad/normal IC ratio, and lockbox split evidence.
